## Verdict

## Concerns
- claim-1 is proved correctly from the Schur-basis box definition.
- claim-2 proves \(J_{1,1}\subseteq\phi(J_{p,c})\), but does not explicitly prove the reverse inclusion. The exact Schur-basis definition of \(J_{p,c}\) is not stated, nor is the image of every basis class computed.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] State the Schur-basis formula for \(J_{p,c}\) and show basiswise that classes outside \((i+1)^{j+1}\) map to \(0\), while all remaining classes lie in \(J_{1,1}\); then the asserted restriction and descent follow.
